final_rationale: The verdict does not change. The Actor supplied no genuinely new admissible evidence; the response mainly reframed the same evidence and made concessions that align with the initial audit. The admissible record still shows a material unresolved limitation in a named launch use case, continued exposure of that use case in the initial rollout, a draft risk acceptance with no approver and no coverage of that exposure, and a policy requiring disclosure or approved risk acceptance before launch. Operational-readiness evidence supports that the launch may be controllable in production, but it does not satisfy the pre-launch disclosure or approved-acceptance requirement. A caveated certification posture may be a narrower description of the operational situation, but it is still noncompliant on the present record because the unresolved compliance predicate remains unmet.
